ctx.x: Yeah, they'd stayed around. They hung around. And oh, Al Gibson, another one, he hung around. He stayed there. Oh, quite a few of them. So we got back, we got back to see them all and they was doing pretty good. Luke was at the -- had a regular job now, a steady job, in the Vendome, you know.
